### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4c93f8807e0ed8410b1cafef58adc42763fb6740` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#3 · head 9268c30f · 2026-11-24T01:42Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: `9268c30fe1ad2f538df88d5b4886405938d52f39`
Card: #36701 · claim 7102440904 · os-dev-report 7118868684.

### Checklist
- **Shape:** `l1-face` at this head. Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36701`, no closing keyword next to another card. All three Done-when lines are delivered (below), so `Fixes` is right.
- **Checks at this head:** 68 check-runs. 58 success, 10 expected skip, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check: success. `mergeable_state` clean.
- **Governance:** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 36804`: NOT governed, 287 lines.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` in the body and the changeset; they match the claim. No export moves on a published package, and no file under `packages/spec/**`, so no contract face and no L2 is owed. `record-recognisers --paths` reads no face.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/i18n: patch` (published, new keys) and `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
  - `l1-face` flags `@objectstack/plugin-security` with no entry. That flag is mechanical and wrong here: the only file is `src/*.integration.test.ts`, and the package's `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, so nothing shipped moves.
  - The changeset prose, read sentence by sentence: the action appears beside each setting once it is the member's own; it empties the field on their `(*, *)` row; the page then shows the value in force with its source; the action is not drawn where there is nothing to clear; `enabled` and per-cell rows are untouched; two new keys in all eleven locales. Each matches `followOrganizationWrite`, the page and the locale diff.
- **Premise (the seat's point):** confirmed.
  - Ruling 6968686390 says "'Reset to the admin default' is not built here. It needs a delete … If it is pulled later it is an own-row delete door on its own card." What it keeps out is the delete, and the member grant stays without one.
  - Ruling 7073270426 later made empty a stored state of its own ("not set: follows the next row, in the end the organisation default"). Writing it is an update of the member's own row.
  - The new real-stack pin proves the own-row policy accepts `update(as.alice, own, { digest: null, quiet_hours: null })`. No delete is sent anywhere: `followOrganizationWrite` only returns `kind: 'update'`.
  - The `myPreferences.ts` header sentence is rewritten to cite both rulings. That was the order's "rewrite ~:18" item.
- **Done-when, each against the code:**
  1. The page offers 「跟随组织设置」 for digest and for quiet hours, beside each source line. It is drawn only when `ownRowId` is set and the door says `source: 'own'`, which includes the explicit off. It is hidden for `default`, `builtin` and `mandatory`, and disabled with the read-only reason when the member may not write.
  2. After clearing, `apply` re-reads the door and resets the quiet-hours draft, so the source line shows the organization default. The integration test shows a later change of the organization row reaching the member (`source: 'default'`).
  3. Round trip pinned: save `weekly` / own window, clear both, and the resolver answers the organization's `daily` / window. Then the organization changes, and the resolver follows.
- **UI strings:** two keys, `followOrganization` and `followOrganizationFor` (the aria-label with `«setting»`), in all eleven locales. zh-Hans 「跟随组织设置」 / 「«setting»：跟随组织设置」, zh-Hant 「跟隨組織設定」, en, and real translations for ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR and ru (none is an English copy).
- **Scope:** the order allowed `notification-settings/**`, the app-shell locale bundles and an app-shell changeset. Two declared deviations sit outside it, each with its reason:
  - the locale packs live in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*`, the pattern the page's other strings use, so they carry an `@object-ui/i18n` entry;
  - the +48 test in `plugin-security`, the real-server pin the order asked for ("with a real test against the server code").

  The claim's `File surface:` line should be amended with both (seat, paper).
- **Tests:** real commands with output.
  - notification-settings: 3 files, 52 tests. The plugin-security integration file: 38 tests (37 + the round trip). `@object-ui/i18n`: 109 files.
  - Ablation: `followOrganizationWrite` always returning null turned 6 red.
  - `check:i18n` was NOT MEASURED locally (no build); CI's label and i18n gates are green on this head.

### Findings
Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none.

- **N1 (nit, no user effect):** `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so its changeset line never publishes. It is harmless, and Check Changeset is green. It can stay.

### Landing notes
`Fixes #36701`: merging closes the card; `pm:dispatched` comes off at close-out.
